name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
readmeExcerpt:
# agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. ## Install ```bash npm install -g agent-browser agent-browser install # download Chrome for Testing (first time only) ``` - **Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. - **Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. - **No install:** `npx agent-browser open example.com`. Project installs, building from source, `upgrade`, and `doctor` are covered in [Installation](https://agent-browser.dev/installation). ## Quick start ```bash agent-browser open example.com agent-browser snapshot -i # interactive elements, each with a ref agent-browser click @e1 # act on a ref from that snapshot agent-browser get url # check the result agent-browser close ``` The snapshot for `example.com`: ``` - link "Learn more" [ref=e1] ``` - Refs describe the page at the time of the snapshot. After navigation or a DOM change, take a new snapshot before using refs again. - CSS selectors, text, XPath, and semantic locators also work, for example `agent-browser find role button click --name "Submit"`. See [Selectors](https://agent-browser.dev/selectors). - A click fails, instead of reporting success, when the target is hidden, disabled, outside the viewport, or covered by another element such as a consent banner. analysis.oneLine: agent-browser 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: agent-browser 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，agent-browser 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 49,970，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 Rust 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
